environment.description: Same application deployed in a hardened container on ECS Fargate. The task definition specifies a custom AppArmor profile 'corp-node-restricted' loaded via ECS agent configuration. The profile denies all file operations outside /var/lib/app/data.db (read/write), /etc/app/config.json (read-only), and the node_modules directory (read-only). Specifically: deny /tmp/** rwklx, deny /var/log/** w, deny /proc/*/environ r. The profile uses 'deny' rules which cannot be overridden. SQLite ATTACH DATABASE and LOAD_EXTENSION are blocked because the process cannot create or open any file descriptors outside the whitelisted paths. The container runs with no-new-privileges and drops all capabilities except CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE.
